video:video.video:title: DBX explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: DBX is a free database client that opens 100+ kinds of databases in a 25 MB app. Its AI helper turns plain English into database queries for you.

video:video.video:title: PureMac explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: PureMac is a free CleanMyMac alternative. It clears junk, fully uninstalls apps and finds duplicates, with no subscription, no tracking and no scare tactics.

video:video.video:title: Strata explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Strata is a free installer that runs big, private local AI on a gaming PC. It sets up a large Qwen model, so your chats never leave your computer.

video:video.video:title: Recordly explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Recordly is a free screen recorder and editor for Mac, Windows and Linux. It adds auto-zooms, a smooth cursor, webcam bubbles and styled backgrounds.

video:video.video:title: OpenSEO explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: OpenSEO is a free Semrush alternative for keyword research, rank tracking and site audits. It's open source, and you pay only for the search data you use.

video:video.video:title: Tolaria explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Tolaria is a free offline notes app for Mac, Windows and Linux. Your notes are plain files you own, with full version history and no account.

video:video.video:title: PhotoCraft explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: PhotoCraft is a free PSD editor that works like Photoshop. It opens and saves real layered PSD files and runs offline on Mac, Windows and Linux.

video:video.video:title: OpenReel explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: OpenReel is a free online video editor with no watermark. Cut clips, add captions, mix music and export up to 4K, right in your web browser.

video:video.video:title: Odysseus explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Odysseus is a free self-hosted AI workspace for chat, deep research, documents, email, notes and calendar. You run it yourself, so your data stays with you.

video:video.video:title: Moli explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Moli is a free headless browser for AI agents. It lets AI helpers read, search and use websites fast, while using far less memory than Chrome.

video:video.video:title: OpenPencil explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: OpenPencil is a free Figma alternative. It opens and saves .fig files, builds designs from a chat prompt, and lets you co-edit live with no account.

video:video.video:title: Thaw explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Thaw is a free Mac menu bar manager that hides, sorts and styles the icons at the top of your screen. Open source, no tracking and no account.

video:video.video:title: openGym explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: openGym is a free workout tracker app you own. Plan routines, follow guided sessions with 5,600+ exercises, and log weight. No subscription, no ads.

video:video.video:title: Compositor explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Compositor is a free Photoshop alternative for Mac with layers, masks, blend modes and Photoshop-style shortcuts. It opens PSD files and has no subscription.

video:video.video:title: Cloudflare Security Audit explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Cloudflare's Security Audit skill is a free AI code security check. It turns your AI coding helper into a careful reviewer that writes a clear report.

video:video.video:title: Hindsight explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Hindsight is free, open-source AI agent memory. It helps AI helpers remember past chats and learn from them. Works with Claude Code, Codex and 60+ tools.

video:video.video:title: Brag explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Brag is a free AI launch video maker. Type one command in Claude Code or Codex and it turns your project into a short video with music and share text.

video:video.video:title: Artemis explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Artemis is free AI Android automation from Google. Type a task in plain English and an AI taps, swipes and tests apps on a real Android phone for you.

video:video.video:title: Vorssaint Utils explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Vorssaint Utils is a free Mac utility app. Per-app volume, window snapping, clipboard history, a system monitor and an uninstaller behind one menu bar icon.

video:video.video:title: Diagram Design explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Diagram Design is a free AI diagram generator. Ask your AI helper in plain words and get a clean, on-brand diagram in one file you can open anywhere.

video:video.video:title: DeepSeek Harness explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: DeepSeek Harness is DeepSeek's free, open-source AI agent. Every feature is a plugin you can swap or build, and it runs in your browser with one command.

video:video.video:title: OpenLogi explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: OpenLogi is a free Logitech Options+ alternative. Remap mouse buttons, tune your webcam and control Litra lights on Mac, Windows and Linux.

video:video.video:title: OfficeCLI explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: OfficeCLI is free AI for Word, Excel and PowerPoint. It lets AI helpers create, read and edit real Office files, with no Office install needed.

video:video.video:title: Archify explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Archify is a free AI diagram generator. Describe an idea, plan or codebase to Claude Code or Codex and get an interactive diagram as one shareable web page.

video:video.video:title: Colibri explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Colibri is a free tool to run large AI models locally on the computer you already own. No graphics card needed: it reads most of the model from disk.

video:video.video:title: Meetily explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Meetily is a free AI meeting note taker. It transcribes your calls live and writes summaries on your own computer, so recordings never have to leave it.

video:video.video:title: Hallmark explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Hallmark is a free AI web design skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. It steers your AI away from generic pages so each site looks like its own brand.

video:video.video:title: AI Job Search explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: AI Job Search helps you tailor your CV with AI for every job. It scores postings, writes cover letters and builds interview prep packs on your computer.

video:video.video:title: OpenCut explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: OpenCut is a free CapCut alternative you can use in your browser today. It's open source, and a full rewrite for desktop, mobile and AI agents is on the way.

video:video.video:title: Headroom explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Headroom is a free tool to reduce AI token costs. It shrinks logs, files and data on your computer before your AI reads them, so answers stay the same.

video:video.video:title: Pake explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Pake lets you turn any website into a desktop app with one command. Apps are often under 10 MB. Ready-made ChatGPT, Gemini and Notion apps too. Free.

video:video.video:title: Apple Container explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Apple Container is Apple's free tool to run Linux containers on Mac. Each one runs in a tiny virtual machine, tuned for Apple silicon and macOS 26.

video:video.video:title: Ponytail Skill explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: The Ponytail skill is one free prompt that makes your AI coding helper reuse what exists, write half the code, and still keep the tests and safety checks.

video:video.video:title: Open Notebook explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Open Notebook is a free NotebookLM alternative you run yourself. Chat with your PDFs and videos, get cited answers, and turn notes into podcasts.

video:video.video:title: OpenMontage explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: OpenMontage is a free AI video maker. Describe a video in plain words and your AI helper researches, scripts, narrates, edits and renders it for you.

video:video.video:title: Understand Anything explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Understand Anything is a free plugin that lets you visualize any codebase as a clickable map with plain-English notes, guided tours and a chat for questions.

video:video.video:title: Matt Pocock Skills explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Matt Pocock skills are free add-ons that make Claude Code, Codex and Copilot ask better questions, test their work and keep your code tidy.

video:video.video:title: OpenHuman explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: OpenHuman is an open source AI agent app for Mac, Windows and Linux. Its agents browse, search, remember and use your apps while using less power.

video:video.video:title: OpenDesign explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: OpenDesign is a free open source AI design tool. It uses Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to make on-brand prototypes, slide decks, dashboards and images.

video:video.video:title: CodeGraph for Claude Code explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: CodeGraph for Claude Code builds a local map of your code, so your AI helper finds the right files in one step. Free, MIT licensed, runs on your computer.

video:video.video:title: Karpathy Skills for Claude Code explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Karpathy skills for Claude Code is one free rules file that makes your AI coder ask first, keep code simple and only change what you asked for.

video:video.video:title: Hermes Agent explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Hermes Agent is a free self-improving AI agent from Nous Research. It remembers you, learns new skills, and chats with you on Telegram, Slack or WhatsApp.

video:video.video:title: Graphify Knowledge Graph explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: A graphify knowledge graph turns your code, docs, PDFs and videos into one clickable map, so your AI helper looks things up instead of guessing.

video:video.video:title: Caveman explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Caveman is a free add-on to reduce Claude Code token usage. Your AI helper gives short answers and reads less noise, so each session costs less.

video:video.video:title: Career-Ops explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Career-Ops is a free AI job search tool. It checks each job against your CV, tells you when to skip, and drafts tailored CVs and cover letters.

video:video.video:title: Awesome DESIGN.md explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Awesome DESIGN.md is a free set of 84 DESIGN.md files for AI. Drop one in your project and Claude Code or Cursor builds pages in that site's style.

video:video.video:title: MemPalace explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: MemPalace is free AI memory for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. It saves your chats word for word on your own computer and finds the right one later.

video:video.video:title: RTK explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: RTK is a free tool to reduce Claude Code token usage. It trims noisy command output before your AI coding helper reads it. Works with Codex and Cursor too.

video:video.video:title: Karpathy autoresearch explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Karpathy autoresearch lets an AI agent tweak, train and test a tiny AI model on its own overnight, keeping only the changes that make it better.

video:video.video:title: gstack explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: gstack claude code skills turn Claude Code into a free virtual team: a CEO, designer, code reviewer, QA tester and release engineer. Here's how to start.

video:video.video:title: CorridorKey explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: CorridorKey is free AI green screen removal. It pulls people off green or blue screens and keeps fine hair, motion blur and see-through edges clean.

video:video.video:title: Paperclip explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Paperclip is a free, self-hosted app to manage AI agents like a company, with goals, an org chart, budgets, approvals and one dashboard for all the work.

video:video.video:title: Project NOMAD explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Project NOMAD is a free offline knowledge server with Wikipedia, medical guides, Khan Academy courses, maps and a local AI that work with no internet.

video:video.video:title: ECC explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: ECC is a free Claude Code plugin with 71 agents, 311 skills, memory and a security scanner. It teaches your AI coder to plan, test and review.

video:video.video:title: Superpowers explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Superpowers is a set of free Claude Code skills that make your AI coder ask questions, write a plan, test and review its work before it calls a job done.

video:video.video:title: nanobot explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: nanobot is a free self-hosted AI assistant. Run it on your own computer, then chat in your browser, Telegram, Slack, Discord or email. Here's how.

video:video.video:title: World Monitor explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: World Monitor is a free live world news map. It puts global news, markets and events on one interactive globe, with short AI-written news briefs.

video:video.video:title: Handy explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Handy is a free offline voice typing app. Press a key, talk, and your words appear in any app on Mac, Windows or Linux. Your voice stays on your computer.

video:video.video:title: agent-browser explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: agent-browser is a free AI browser automation tool from Vercel Labs. It lets Claude Code, Codex and other AI helpers open sites, click, fill forms and read.

video:video.video:title: Mole explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: Mole is a free Mac cleaner you run in Terminal. It clears junk, fully removes apps, maps your disk and shows your Mac's health. Open source, no subscription.

video:video.video:title: OpenClaw explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: OpenClaw is a free AI assistant for WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and 20+ more chat apps. It runs on your own computer, so your memory and logins stay with you.

video:video.video:title: VibeVoice explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: VibeVoice is a free AI transcription tool from Microsoft. It turns up to 60 minutes of audio into text and labels who spoke and when.

video:video.video:title: DeepTutor explained in under a minute
video:video.video:description: DeepTutor is a free AI tutor that answers questions, makes quizzes and builds study plans from your own notes, books and videos. Here's how to set it up.
